title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（深見正研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Fukami Tadashi)
educationalGoal:
[Theme]
Our laboratory’s projects focus on novel-structure motors and their drive technologies
[Target]
Through the projects, students will:
(1) Learn how to identify and solve technical issues.
(2) Learn how to write technical reports and deliver presentations.
advice:
[Course Description]
The project is carried out collaboratively by a team of two or more members. A weekly report must be prepared to summarize the project’s progress, and a weekly meeting is held based on this report. For the final review of PD III, a final project report must be submitted and a presentation is required.
[Expectations for Students]
This course is the final stage of the Project Design activities and integrates the knowledge and skills acquired in the other courses. Students are required to review the fundamental subjects and to develop expertise through PD III.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electromagnetics and electric circuits.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clearly define the goal of the project and create a plan to achieve it.
Be able to communicate effectively with team members and pursue the project.
Be able to independently solve the technical challenges in the project.
Be able to compile the project results into a final report (i.e., project report).
Be able to present the project results effectively.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. To understand the problems and propose solutions
2. To carry out the project proactively and obtain results
3. To write a project report
4. To present the results at a conference
5. To write a conference paper
achievementLevels.standard:
1. To understand the problems and explain them
2. To carry out the project according to the schedule
3. To write a project report
4. To present the results at the project presentation meeting
